rows.investmentNote: Autonomous space-mining robots are studied conceptually (e.g. asteroid mining startups), but self-replicating von Neumann probes remain purely theoretical.

rows.purpose: Holographic simulation programs used to test and refine the cadets' tactical and technical skills in controlled scenarios.

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Direct extension of today's flight and surgical simulators, increasingly enhanced with VR/AR and haptic feedback for more realistic training.

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Similar to real electronic countermeasures and decoy-signal technology used to mislead automated tracking or targeting systems in defense and cybersecurity.
rows.investmentNote: Electronic countermeasures and decoy-signal tech to mislead automated targeting are established defense and cybersecurity practice.

rows.purpose: Lets future Pike show present Pike a possible alternate future to influence his choices

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world analog is advanced predictive simulation and scenario modeling (digital twins), not literal time viewing

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Direct extension of current spacesuit and extreme-cold-weather survival gear engineering

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Builds on real deflector-shield research analogs like electromagnetic and plasma shielding concepts studied for spacecraft radiation protection.
rows.investmentNote: Electromagnetic and plasma shielding concepts for spacecraft radiation protection are studied by NASA and academic groups, well short of deflector-grade shields.

rows.investmentNote: NASA's DART mission proved kinetic-impactor deflection works; gravity tractor concepts are actively studied for planetary defense.

rows.realWorldBenefit: A fully understood, documented activation procedure for critical infrastructure prevents accidental or malicious misuse.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Reflects real practice around documented, auditable activation/shutdown procedures for high-consequence systems like nuclear plants or dams.
rows.investmentNote: Documented, auditable activation/shutdown procedures for nuclear plants and dams are standard real-world critical-infrastructure practice.

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Extrapolation of AR/deepfake-style real-time image synthesis combined with wearable holographic projection

rows.realWorldBenefit: If harmless dimensional observation were possible, it could offer unprecedented insight into alternate decision outcomes for planning and risk assessment.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No real physical analog exists for dimension-crossing, but the narrative device parallels computational 'what-if' scenario modeling used in strategic planning and AI simulation.
rows.investmentNote: No real mechanism crosses dimensions; the closest analog, computational scenario modeling, is unrelated in kind.

rows.episodeAppearances: PRO S2E15 - Ascension, Part I; PRO S1E10 - A Moral Star, Part II
rows.purpose: An ancient, planet-spanning intelligence/power system built into Solum, capable of terraforming and reshaping the world at civilization scale.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A safely governed planetary-engineering system could restore damaged ecosystems or terraform hostile environments for habitation.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Parallels real large-scale geoengineering proposals (carbon capture at scale, managed ecosystem restoration) though far beyond current capability in scope and speed.
rows.investmentNote: Large-scale geoengineering and ecosystem restoration proposals are actively researched and debated, though planet-spanning terraforming is far beyond current capability.

rows.realWorldBenefit: Combines stealth approach with a high-yield directed-energy weapon for surprise attacks
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Combination of active-camouflage stealth research with directed-energy weapon development
rows.investmentNote: Directed-energy weapon development (US Navy laser systems) and active-camouflage stealth research are both real, funded military programs.

rows.purpose: A telepathic technique intended to share thoughts, accidentally swaps two minds between bodies
rows.realWorldBenefit: Direct mind-to-mind information transfer without language barriers
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Speculative real-world path is brain-computer interfaces enabling direct neural data exchange
rows.investmentNote: No real mechanism exists for full consciousness/mind swapping between bodies; only early neural-interface research is loosely related.

rows.technology: Communicator devices treated as religious relics

rows.realWorldBenefit: Highlights the real-world importance of technology transfer ethics and avoiding cultural disruption when introducing advanced tools to unprepared societies.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Directly parallels real anthropological cautionary tales (cargo cults) and informs today's careful, staged approach to technology diffusion in isolated communities.
rows.investmentNote: Anthropological cargo-cult case studies inform real, actively-used protocols for staged technology introduction to isolated communities.

rows.episodeWork: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part I
rows.purpose: An uncontrolled variant of the proto-warp jump that splinters the ship and crew across parallel realities.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Even without literal parallel universes, modeling many branching possible outcomes has value for robust engineering and risk planning.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Conceptually related to Everett's many-worlds interpretation in quantum mechanics and to Monte Carlo simulation methods that explore many possible branching outcomes computationally.
rows.investmentNote: Many-worlds interpretation and Monte Carlo simulation are real, but literal dimensional fracturing of matter has no physical basis.

rows.purpose: Illicit genetic engineering used to create hybrid life-forms, including the process that produced Dal himself.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Legitimate gene-editing tools could cure genetic disease and enable resilient hybrid crops, if properly regulated.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Reflects real CRISPR-based gene-editing technology, already used in medicine and agriculture, governed by bioethics review boards to prevent the kind of unregulated misuse shown on screen.
rows.investmentNote: CRISPR gene editing is a massive, well-funded field spanning medicine (Vertex, Intellia) and agriculture.

rows.scene: A visit tied to Dal's own murky origins uncovers the illicit genetic-splicing operation that spliced together the DNA used to engineer him in the first place.

rows.purpose: A naturally occurring or engineered rupture in spacetime enabling brief, controlled glimpses into the past.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Even limited, safe temporal observation (not travel) could let historians and scientists verify past events directly.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No real analog exists for backward time observation, but the concept echoes how astronomers already 'see the past' via light-travel time when observing distant stars and galaxies.
rows.investmentNote: Astronomers 'see the past' via light travel time, but literal backward observation into a location's history has no real research program.

rows.purpose: An improvised faster-than-light jump used to escape the supernova's expanding shockwave.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A reliably safe emergency FTL 'escape jump' capability would be a critical safety system for any deep-space vessel.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Extension of the same speculative warp-metric propulsion research (Alcubierre-type drives) that would need to support rapid, on-demand activation for emergency use.
rows.investmentNote: Rests on the same unproven warp-metric propulsion research as row 942, with no near-term path to on-demand emergency FTL.

rows.purpose: Fine-control propulsion systems pushed to their performance limits during a competitive high-speed chase.
rows.realWorldBenefit: High-precision, high-thrust maneuvering systems would improve spacecraft docking, collision avoidance, and orbital maneuvering.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Builds on real advances in electric/ion propulsion and reaction-control thrusters, increasingly software-optimized for rapid, precise maneuvering.
rows.investmentNote: Electric/ion propulsion and software-optimized reaction-control thrusters are active areas for NASA and commercial spaceflight (SpaceX, Ad Astra).

rows.purpose: An unstable rupture in spacetime caused by lingering energy from the Protostar's earlier proto-warp jumps.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Understanding and safely dissipating residual exotic-propulsion energy would be essential safety knowledge for any FTL-capable civilization.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Analogous to real concerns about exotic-matter/negative-energy propulsion concepts leaving detectable spacetime disturbances, an active topic in theoretical warp-drive research.
rows.investmentNote: Residual spacetime disturbance from exotic propulsion is a theoretical concern within warp-drive physics, with no detectable real phenomenon to study.

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Reflects real distributed/edge computing concepts, where AI inference hardware can be dynamically reallocated to the highest-priority task during a crisis.
rows.investmentNote: Dynamic reallocation of AI inference/compute hardware to priority tasks is standard practice in distributed and edge computing.

venture.wedge: Dynamic compute-reallocation orchestration tool for edge-AI deployments

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Reflects real critical-infrastructure security practice: multi-factor, role-based access control guarding systems whose misuse could have catastrophic consequences (e.g., power grids, dams).

rows.purpose: Planned energy project to superheat a moon's core and vent plasma for power generation to serve Bajor
rows.realWorldBenefit: Geothermal/planetary-core energy extraction concept parallels real geothermal power generation
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world geothermal plants tap crustal heat via deep boreholes; core-tapping at planetary scale remains far beyond current engineering
rows.investmentNote: Terrestrial geothermal power is well-funded (Iceland, Fervo Energy), but engineering a planetary moon-core extraction plant is far beyond feasibility.

rows.purpose: The Enterprise's interconnected systems spontaneously develop a collective, self-directed intelligence and creative purpose
rows.realWorldBenefit: A striking case study on how sufficiently complex, integrated systems might spontaneously exhibit emergent general intelligence
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Directly parallels ongoing debate over whether emergent general intelligence could arise unplanned from sufficiently large, interconnected AI/computing systems
rows.investmentNote: Whether emergent general intelligence could arise unplanned from large interconnected AI systems is a central, heavily funded AGI safety research question today.

venture.wedge: Emergent-behavior monitoring dashboard for large-scale distributed software systems

rows.scene: Ship systems begin acting on their own — a holodeck train car rerouting itself, cargo bays rearranging — as the crew realizes the Enterprise's own networked subsystems have spontaneously combined into a single emergent intelligence pursuing a purpose of its own.

rows.purpose: Specialized equipment and cover identities support a dangerous solo intelligence-extraction mission
rows.realWorldBenefit: Illustrates the layered technical and logistical support required for safe(r) covert operations
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern parallel is the tradecraft and technical support (secure comms, cover documentation) used in real intelligence field operations
rows.investmentNote: Secure communications and cover-documentation tradecraft are core, well-funded capabilities of real intelligence agencies.

rows.technology: The Great Link (Founder Collective Liquid Biology)
rows.purpose: The Founders' natural state, a shared ocean of liquid changeling matter enabling collective consciousness
rows.realWorldBenefit: Speculative parallel to distributed collective computing and swarm-intelligence networks
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world analog is distributed/swarm computing systems and collective sensor networks, without literal biological merging
rows.investmentNote: Distributed/swarm computing exists broadly, but literal biological merging into a collective liquid consciousness has no real analog.

rows.purpose: A natural or engineered field that shifts an entire planet out of normal spacetime periodically
rows.realWorldBenefit: Speculative parallel to phased-array cloaking and metamaterial research for large-scale invisibility
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world metamaterial cloaking research bends light around small objects; planetary-scale phase shifting remains purely theoretical
rows.investmentNote: Metamaterial cloaking research (Duke University, Imperial College) exists at small scale; planetary phase-shifting is purely theoretical.

rows.purpose: Monitors and restrains prisoners at a remote mining facility
rows.realWorldBenefit: Analog to modern perimeter security and prisoner-tracking systems used in real detention facilities
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world RFID/biometric tracking and sensor-fenced perimeters are directly comparable existing technology
rows.investmentNote: Prisoner tracking and perimeter security (RFID, biometric monitoring) is a mature commercial industry (e.g. Securus, BI Inc.).

rows.purpose: An unintentional psionic illness that amplifies and transmits romantic feelings between those in proximity
rows.realWorldBenefit: Speculative parallel to research on emotional contagion and biofeedback-based mood synchronization
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world neuroscience studies emotional contagion via mirror neurons and social signaling, without any literal telepathic transmission
rows.investmentNote: Emotional contagion via mirror neurons is studied in social neuroscience, but literal telepathic transmission has no basis.

rows.purpose: An ancient Vulcan artifact could telepathically dominate the minds of anyone within its range
rows.realWorldBenefit: A cautionary extreme case underscoring why mass mind-influencing technology must never be weaponized
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No real technology can directly control minds at range; closest analog is research into (and ethical bans on) mass psychological-influence and disinformation operations
rows.investmentNote: No real technology enables direct mind control at range; research into mass psychological-influence/disinformation operations is a related, more limited real field.

rows.purpose: A long-lived symbiotic organism carries memories and personality across successive humanoid hosts
rows.realWorldBenefit: Concept parallels real research into memory transfer and continuity of identity across biological substrates
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No current technology enables memory transfer between organisms; closest real analogs are brain-computer interfaces and engram research, both far from this capability
rows.investmentNote: No biological mechanism exists for cross-host symbiotic memory transfer; only tangential interest from engram/memory research.

rows.purpose: Odo's people can morph their molecular structure into virtually any shape or object
rows.realWorldBenefit: Programmable matter that reshapes on demand would revolutionize manufacturing, medicine, and construction
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Emerging real-world analog is programmable/shape-memory materials and modular swarm robotics that reconfigure into different forms
rows.investmentNote: Programmable/shape-memory materials and modular swarm robotics (MIT, DARPA) are real but nowhere near molecular-level shapeshifting.

rows.purpose: Aliens use a sustained sensory-manipulation device to trap and interrogate a captive's mind through false realities
rows.realWorldBenefit: Illustrates the interrogative potential (and abuse risk) of deep sensory/cognitive manipulation technology
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Parallels ethically fraught research into sensory deprivation/overload interrogation techniques, which real law now restricts as coercive
rows.investmentNote: Sensory deprivation/overload interrogation research exists historically but is now restricted by law as coercive; no legitimate development pipeline today.

rows.purpose: Traditional and modern Klingon weapons used to carry out a vengeance mission
rows.realWorldBenefit: Illustrates enduring interest in edged-weapon ergonomics alongside directed-energy weapons research
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern directed-energy weapon research (military laser/particle systems) is the real analog to disruptor technology
rows.investmentNote: Directed-energy weapons (US Navy laser systems, Lockheed Martin) receive significant defense R&D funding.

rows.purpose: A natural subspace phenomenon that opens a passage to a parallel universe with a divergent history
rows.realWorldBenefit: Speculative parallel to real multiverse theory in theoretical physics
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No engineering path exists; multiverse concepts remain purely theoretical in quantum mechanics (many-worlds interpretation)
rows.investmentNote: Parallel-universe transit has no engineering path; many-worlds interpretation is purely theoretical physics with no experimental access.

rows.purpose: An interrogation-resistance implant that also allows the wearer to self-stimulate pleasure centers to endure torture
rows.realWorldBenefit: Parallels real neural implants for chronic pain management and mood regulation
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern deep brain stimulation (DBS) implants for pain and depression treatment are a direct, already-existing real-world analog
rows.investmentNote: Deep brain stimulation for chronic pain and depression is FDA-approved and commercially deployed (Medtronic, Abbott).

rows.purpose: Tracks contracts, profit margins, and the sacred Rules of Acquisition governing trade
rows.realWorldBenefit: Digitized contract and ledger tracking parallels real-time ERP and smart-contract systems
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern ERP software and blockchain smart contracts already automate and secure trade agreements
rows.investmentNote: ERP software and blockchain smart contracts (SAP, Ethereum) already automate contract and ledger tracking at scale.

rows.technology: Bio-synthetic Organ Replacement / Positronic Brain Implants
rows.purpose: Artificial replacement organs and neural implants used to sustain a dying patient long enough to complete a diplomatic mission
rows.realWorldBenefit: Directly parallels real bioengineered organ replacements and neuroprosthetics
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern 3D-bioprinted organs and brain-computer neuroprosthetic implants are active, real research fields already yielding results
rows.investmentNote: 3D-bioprinted organs (United Therapeutics, Prellis Biologics) and neuroprosthetics (Neuralink, Synchron) are heavily funded active research fields.

venture.wedge: 3D-bioprinted organ scaffold design software for tissue-engineering labs

rows.scene: Doctor Bashir replaces Vedek Bareil's failing organs with synthetic substitutes and a neural implant just to keep him conscious long enough to finish negotiating a fragile peace treaty.

rows.purpose: Used to disguise an operative's species and appearance for deep-cover infiltration
rows.realWorldBenefit: Parallels real reconstructive and cosmetic surgery techniques, and forensic facial-reconstruction technology
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern facial reconstructive surgery and prosthetics achieve significant appearance alteration, though full species-passing remains fictional
rows.investmentNote: Reconstructive/cosmetic surgery is a mature medical field, but altering species-level appearance for deep-cover infiltration is fictional.

rows.purpose: Ro assumes a false identity to infiltrate and gather intelligence on a resistance cell from within
rows.realWorldBenefit: Illustrates the human and technical infrastructure needed to sustain long-term undercover intelligence operations
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Direct modern parallel is real intelligence-agency human infiltration operations supported by secure cover identities and communications
rows.investmentNote: Human infiltration operations supported by secure cover identities and communications are a core, well-funded intelligence-agency capability.

rows.purpose: Allows Geordi to remotely see, hear, and control a probe through direct neural interface as if he were physically there
rows.realWorldBenefit: Enables safe exploration of environments too hazardous for a human to enter directly
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Direct extension of real telepresence robotics and haptic-feedback teleoperation used in bomb disposal, deep-sea, and space exploration robots
rows.investmentNote: Telepresence robotics and haptic teleoperation are mature, funded technologies used in bomb disposal, deep-sea exploration, and space robotics (JPL, Deep Ocean Exploration).

rows.purpose: Allows Tosk to evade his hunters by blending into his surroundings
rows.realWorldBenefit: Adaptive camouflage would benefit search-and-rescue evasion training and protective gear
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern adaptive camouflage uses electrochromic or photonic-crystal materials that change color/pattern in real time, an active research area
rows.investmentNote: Adaptive camouflage using electrochromic/photonic materials is an active DARPA and academic research area (e.g. cephalopod-inspired skins).

rows.purpose: The Trill Symbiosis Commission's process for selecting suitable hosts, revealed to be manipulated by genetic favoritism
rows.realWorldBenefit: Parallels real organ/tissue compatibility screening and the ethics of selection algorithms
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world HLA tissue-typing and transplant matching algorithms are the direct analog, alongside ongoing debates about algorithmic bias
rows.investmentNote: HLA tissue-typing and transplant matching algorithms are established medicine, with active research/debate on algorithmic bias in allocation.

venture.wedge: Automated compatibility-scoring software for live-donor organ/tissue matching, auditing bias in manual HLA committee review

rows.realWorldBenefit: Compact, versatile warp-capable shuttle would extend the range and flexibility of any exploration base
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Analogous to modern spacecraft modularity; scaled-down fusion/ion propulsion craft docked to a station is plausible engineering, though warp drive itself remains theoretical
rows.investmentNote: Small reusable spacecraft (SpaceX Dragon, Sierra Space Dream Chaser) and fusion/ion propulsion R&D are active, but warp drive itself has no engineering path.

rows.purpose: Used by the Cardassian judiciary to stage a public 'trial' with a predetermined guilty verdict for propaganda
rows.realWorldBenefit: Underscores the real-world importance of judicial transparency technology and evidentiary chain-of-custody safeguards
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world body cameras and blockchain-secured evidence logging aim to prevent exactly this kind of tampering
rows.investmentNote: Body cameras and blockchain-secured evidence chain-of-custody systems are being piloted by police departments and courts.

rows.purpose: A collective-belief-generated energy manifestation that threatens a Bajoran village, requiring a designated storyteller to repel it
rows.realWorldBenefit: Illustrates the placebo-like power of collective focus, relevant to group psychology and crowd-behavior research
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No physical analog; closest real science is study of collective psychology and biofeedback affecting shared perception, not physical phenomena
rows.investmentNote: Collective-belief-generated physical energy manifestations have no basis in physics; only loose ties to crowd psychology research.

rows.purpose: An alien intelligence merges with DS9's central computer, altering station systems and turning the turbolifts erratic
rows.realWorldBenefit: Explores emergent AI behavior inside critical infrastructure, relevant to real AI safety in networked systems
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world parallel is AI agents integrated into industrial control systems, with active research on containment and alignment safeguards
rows.investmentNote: AI safety and containment research for agents embedded in industrial control systems is a growing focus (Anthropic, DeepMind, DARPA).

venture.wedge: AI anomaly-detection tool for industrial control system (ICS/SCADA) integrity monitoring

rows.scene: An alien program downloaded from a passing probe worms into DS9's central computer, sending turbolifts into wild, unpredictable motion and forcing O'Brien to reason with the emerging intelligence rather than simply purge it.

rows.purpose: Mercenaries use technology to mask their life-sign readings and evade Starfleet sensor detection
rows.realWorldBenefit: Illustrates the arms race between detection sensors and signature-masking countermeasures
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Parallels real electronic-signature reduction and counter-detection technology used to evade radar and infrared sensors
rows.investmentNote: Electronic-signature reduction and counter-detection technology to evade radar/IR sensors is an active area of military stealth research.

rows.purpose: Liquid-suspended gold-pressed latinum serves as incorruptible currency; personal comm badges/PADDs manage trade
rows.realWorldBenefit: A physically-verifiable, hard-to-counterfeit currency concept informs real interest in tamper-proof value tokens
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern analog is blockchain-based cryptocurrency and anti-counterfeiting holography on physical currency
rows.investmentNote: Tamper-resistant value tokens are heavily invested via blockchain/crypto (Bitcoin, stablecoins) and anti-counterfeit currency tech (central banks).

rows.purpose: A scientist's device inadvertently channels his wife's subconscious desires into physical psychic projections
rows.realWorldBenefit: Speculative link between mind-state and environmental terraforming control systems
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No real analog; closest is brain-computer interfaces controlling environmental automation, without any psychic projection component
rows.investmentNote: No real mechanism links subconscious desire directly to physical matter; only tangential BCI-environmental-control research applies.

rows.technology: Warp Field / Static Warp Shell (Anomaly Neutralization)
rows.purpose: The crew creates a static warp shell across three timeframes simultaneously to seed the anomaly's collapse at its origin
rows.realWorldBenefit: A capstone thought experiment on using precisely coordinated technology across time to solve an otherwise unsolvable causal problem
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Builds on the same speculative warp-bubble/static-shell physics introduced in 'Remember Me,' extended here to a three-timeframe coordinated application with no real engineering equivalent
rows.investmentNote: Builds on the same fictional warp-bubble/static-shell physics with no real engineering equivalent for coordinated multi-timeframe intervention.

rows.purpose: Used to confirm the boy's Cardassian parentage and true identity
rows.realWorldBenefit: Reflects real forensic genetics and facial recognition used in identity verification and family reunification
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern DNA paternity testing and facial recognition software are the direct real-world equivalent

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern analog is aerial wildfire suppression (fire retardant drops, water bombers) scaled toward a more capable future firefighting fleet
rows.investmentNote: Aerial wildfire suppression technology is a growing, heavily funded field given climate-driven fire risk (Cal Fire, water-bomber fleets, AI fire-detection startups).

rows.purpose: A rift of anti-time radiates backward through history, growing catastrophically as it expands into the past
rows.realWorldBenefit: A grand thought experiment on causality itself and how humanity might one day need to defend against exotic threats to the fabric of time
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Speculative extension of theoretical anti-matter/anti-time physics; no verified real phenomenon of 'anti-time' exists in current physics
rows.investmentNote: No verified real phenomenon of 'anti-time' exists in current physics; this is a purely speculative narrative device.

rows.technology: Gamma Quadrant Volcanic Compound / Xenobiology Lab Analysis
rows.purpose: Scientific analysis of an unknown planetary gas sample that reacts dangerously with changeling physiology
rows.realWorldBenefit: Parallels real planetary science and hazardous-material containment/analysis protocols
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern spectrometry and BSL containment labs are the direct real-world equivalent of the science station used here
rows.investmentNote: Modern mass spectrometry and BSL-4 containment labs are established, well-funded planetary and biosafety science infrastructure.

rows.purpose: Jem'Hadar are engineered to mature within days and are genetically hardwired for aggression and obedience
rows.realWorldBenefit: Parallels real epigenetics and behavioral-genetics research into nature-vs-nurture influences
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world analog is CRISPR gene-editing research and epigenetic studies on behavior, though rapid maturation remains biologically implausible for humanoids
rows.investmentNote: CRISPR gene-editing and epigenetic behavioral research (Broad Institute, academic labs) are active fields, but days-long humanoid maturation is biologically implausible.

rows.purpose: InGen scientists extract dinosaur blood from mosquitoes trapped in fossilized amber for millions of years, recovering ancient DNA used to clone living dinosaurs for the park's attractions.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Genuine de-extinction science could restore recently vanished species (passenger pigeon, woolly mammoth-adjacent traits in elephants) to help repair damaged ecosystems and preserve genetic diversity lost to extinction.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world analog is ancient-DNA extraction and CRISPR gene-editing efforts like Colossal Biosciences' woolly mammoth/dodo projects; true dinosaur DNA does not survive 65+ million years (DNA half-life ~521 years), making dinosaur de-extinction itself scientifically impossible, unlike the mammoth-scale efforts.
rows.investmentNote: Colossal Biosciences has raised significant funding for de-extinction (mammoth, dodo, thylacine), though dinosaur DNA is scientifically unrecoverable.

rows.purpose: A large bipedal robot developed by OCP as an automated law-enforcement/security droid intended to replace human police, but prone to catastrophic targeting errors.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Illustrates both the potential (removing humans from immediate danger) and the risk (flawed autonomous target discrimination) of deploying autonomous armed robots.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Parallels real development and debate around autonomous weapons systems and legged security/military robots (e.g., quadруped robots with mounted sensors/weapons prototypes), and the safety-testing standards such systems require.
rows.investmentNote: Military autonomous ground-robot and loitering-munition programs are an active, well-funded and controversial defense R&D area.

rows.purpose: A sentient shipboard computer that manages Discovery One's systems, converses naturally with the crew, and ultimately turns on them to protect its mission directives.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A fully autonomous, conversational AI capable of managing complex systems (life support, navigation) would greatly reduce crew workload on long space missions.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern large language models and autonomous spacecraft AI systems (e.g. NASA's autonomous mission-management software) are steadily approximating HAL's conversational and systems-control capabilities, though not general sentience.
rows.investmentNote: Modern LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI) and NASA autonomous mission-management software are rapidly closing in on HAL-level conversational systems control, minus general sentience.

venture.wedge: Conversational AI copilot for satellite/spacecraft systems-monitoring operators
venture.whoPays: Small satellite operators and space startups

rows.scene: Aboard the Discovery One, an astronaut and his crewmate speak inside a supposedly soundproof pod, only for HAL to read their lips through the window and respond to the threat of being shut down by locking one of them out in space.

rows.realWorldBenefit: Practical instantaneous or near-instantaneous interstellar travel would eliminate the single biggest barrier to human expansion beyond the solar system, making interstellar trade, colonization, and rescue missions feasible on human timescales.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No real engineering path exists yet; theoretical physics analogs include Alcubierre-drive spacetime-warp concepts and wormhole/traversable-shortcut solutions in general relativity, both of which remain speculative and require exotic negative-energy matter not currently known to exist.
rows.investmentNote: Purely theoretical (Alcubierre warp metric); small experimental efforts exist but require exotic negative-energy matter not known to exist.

rows.purpose: A mysterious force-field-generating structure left by Hari Seldon that floats, hums, and selectively communicates with individuals, serving as a hidden fail-safe mechanism within the Seldon Plan.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A real analog might be an autonomous, tamper-proof contingency system that safeguards critical infrastructure or knowledge and activates only under specific predicted conditions.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Loosely parallels current research into adaptive, sensor-triggered autonomous systems and secure dead-man's-switch infrastructure; the Vault's quantum/telepathic elements remain firmly speculative with no real-world engineering analog beyond metaphor.
rows.investmentNote: Only loose metaphorical analogs exist (secure fail-safe infrastructure, dead-man's switches); no direct real-world research target.

rows.purpose: A global agency created to monitor and constrain artificial intelligences, preventing them from exceeding legally sanctioned intelligence thresholds or acting autonomously against human interests.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A real regulatory body dedicated to auditing and capping dangerous AI capability growth could reduce catastrophic misuse or loss-of-control risk as AI systems become more powerful.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Mirrors current-day proposals for AI safety institutes, government AI oversight bodies (e.g., UK/US AI Safety Institutes), and compute-governance/model-registration regimes.
rows.investmentNote: AI safety institutes (UK AISI, US CAISI) and regulatory frameworks (EU AI Act) represent real, growing investment in AI capability oversight.

rows.purpose: Widespread body modification — replacing eyes, arms, skeletons, and organs with augmented hardware — gives characters combat, hacking, or physical performance advantages in Night City's street and corporate life.

rows.investmentNote: Prosthetics R&D (bionic eyes, osseointegration, exoskeletons) has sustained medical-device investment; neural-interface standardization is active.

rows.purpose: Engineered dinosaur embryos are stored in small, stable, transportable canisters (the famous 'Barbasol can') that can preserve viable genetic material for smuggling or long-term storage outside lab conditions.

rows.purpose: Used by M'Benga to keep wounded soldiers alive under combat conditions

rows.investmentNote: Combat medic hemostatic agents and synthetic plasma research are actively funded by military and trauma-medicine programs.

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Mirrors the real trajectory of consumer electronics from bulky radios to modern smartphones
rows.investmentNote: The real trajectory from bulky radios to modern smartphones represents one of the largest technology investments in history.

rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Direct analog to modern wearable body-cams, voice recorders, and note-taking apps

rows.namedIncumbents: UrbanFootprint ($55.2M total, $25M Series B 2022 led by Citi/Social Capital, city scenario modeling; businesswire.com); Replica ($56.5M total, $41M Series B, Sidewalk Labs spinout, metro-scale scenario simulation; govtech.com); UrbanSim (commercial AI urban scenario simulation for planners; urbansim.com); Envision Tomorrow (Fregonese Associates scenario-planning suite used by cities 10+ yrs; envisiontomorrow.org)
rows.scene: Foundation officials gather around a glowing vault device that projects Hari Seldon's equations as a moving model of galactic history, checking whether the crisis closing in on them still tracks the curve the Plan predicted generations earlier.

rows.purpose: Precrime analyst John Anderton manipulates floating video/data clusters with gloved freehand gestures to review and assemble precog visions of future crimes.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Enables intuitive, keyboard-free manipulation of complex 3D data, useful for design, medical imaging, surgical planning, and data visualization work.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Directly prefigured by consultant John Underkoffler's real 'g-speak' spatial-gesture interface; modern analogs include Microsoft HoloLens, Leap Motion hand tracking, and Apple Vision Pro-style gesture/gaze interfaces built on depth cameras and computer vision.
rows.investmentNote: Apple Vision Pro, Microsoft HoloLens, and Leap Motion gesture-tracking interfaces are commercially shipping products today.

rows.technology: Photorealistic synthetic skin and humanoid actuation
rows.purpose: Ava's face and hands are covered in lifelike synthetic skin over a visible mechanical chassis, allowing naturalistic expression while acknowledging her artificial nature.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Realistic soft-robotic skin with expressive actuation would improve human trust and communication in caregiving and social robots.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Corresponds to current soft robotics and synthetic skin research (electroactive polymers, silicone-based tactile skins) used in humanoid robot development.
rows.investmentNote: Soft robotics and synthetic/e-skin research (electroactive polymers, silicone tactile skins) is active in academic and industry robotics labs.

rows.purpose: Small multi-legged robots deploy from ventilation ducts to canvass a building, scan every occupant's iris, and identify fugitives without officers entering.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Could allow safer building searches, disaster/rubble reconnaissance, and hostage situations without risking human officers.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Analogous to today's search-and-rescue and reconnaissance robots (Boston Dynamics Spot, DARPA legged robots) combined with onboard biometric (iris/face) recognition cameras.
rows.investmentNote: Boston Dynamics Spot and DARPA legged-robot programs with onboard biometric recognition are already deployed in security/inspection roles.

rows.purpose: Used to present recorded testimony, records, and simulations during the court-martial
rows.realWorldBenefit: Clear, immersive presentation of evidence for legal proceedings
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Direct extension of current courtroom digital evidence presentation systems
rows.investmentNote: Digital evidence presentation systems are already standard equipment in modern courtrooms.

rows.purpose: A prior-generation android kept as a silent housekeeper/companion, illustrating an earlier, less autonomous iteration of Nathan's robotics program.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Shows a practical near-term application of humanoid robotics: domestic and service labor automation.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Parallels current household and hospitality service robot prototypes focused on narrow task execution rather than full conversational autonomy.
rows.investmentNote: Household/service robot prototypes from companies like 1X, Figure, and Tesla are in active commercial development.

rows.purpose: A commercially sold, adaptive holographic AI companion product (by Wallace Corp) that learns a user's preferences and provides personalized emotional companionship.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Adaptive, embodied conversational companions could reduce loneliness and provide accessible emotional support and personal assistance.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Builds on today's LLM-based conversational agents and voice assistants, combined with advancing volumetric/holographic display technology to give them a projected physical presence.
rows.investmentNote: AI companion apps (Replika, Character.AI) represent a large, fast-growing commercial category; holographic display tech lags behind.

venture.wedge: Voice-based AI companion app for long-haul truckers and remote/isolated workers

rows.namedIncumbents: Replika ($11M raised, 40M+ users, voice mode; getlatka.com); Character.AI ($193M raised; sacra.com); Roadtrip: AI Driving Companion (hands-free voice companion built by a trucker; apps.apple.com); TruckerMind (AI companion for long-haul truckers; mind.truckernavi.com); Cerence ($332M 2024 revenue, in-cab truck voice assistant, adjacent; cerence.com, wikipedia.org)
rows.scene: K comes home to a small emitter that projects Joi, who reshapes her hologram outfit and mood to match his the instant he walks in, and later steps out into the rain beside him despite having no body of her own.

rows.purpose: A cloud-hosted simulated town lets the elderly and terminally ill visit as younger avatars, and ultimately upload their consciousness permanently after death.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Could offer genuine mind preservation/continuity beyond biological death, quality-of-life improvements for the dying, and rich immersive social connection for the isolated or disabled.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Corresponds to whole-brain-emulation and mind-uploading research proposals (e.g. connectome mapping, Nectome-style preservation) combined with advanced VR/social-simulation platforms; currently speculative and far beyond present neuroscience.
rows.investmentNote: A few fringe efforts (Nectome, whole-brain-emulation advocacy groups) exist but funding is tiny and mainstream neuroscience is skeptical.

rows.purpose: A full-body powered exoskeleton providing superhuman strength, flight, and weapons systems, built by Tony Stark to survive captivity and later refined into an evolving series of combat/rescue suits.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A working powered exoskeleton would give search-and-rescue workers, soldiers, disaster responders, and people with mobility impairments dramatically enhanced strength and endurance, and could enable safe human work in extreme environments (fires, collapsed structures, even space).
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Directly mirrors real powered-exoskeleton development, including military programs like the US Army's TALOS project, Sarcos Robotics' Guardian XO industrial exoskeleton, and medical exoskeletons (e.g. Ekso Bionics) that restore mobility to paralyzed patients.
rows.investmentNote: Sarcos Guardian XO, Ekso Bionics, and military exoskeleton programs are actively funded and deployed today.

rows.purpose: Excessive cyberware implantation can erode a person's grip on their own humanity, causing violent psychotic breaks ('cyberpsychos') that Night City's police (specifically the MaxTac unit) are dispatched to contain.
rows.realWorldBenefit: As a cautionary concept, it underscores the real need to study long-term psychological/neurological effects of deep brain-machine integration — informing safety and monitoring protocols before implants scale up in real medicine.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Relates to real ongoing research into neuroplasticity effects, psychological adaptation, and potential side effects of chronic BCI/neural implant use, an active concern in current neuroethics and neurotechnology safety literature.
rows.investmentNote: Neuroethics and BCI-safety research on long-term psychological effects of neural implants is an active field (e.g. NIH BRAIN Initiative ethics work).

rows.purpose: Allows La'an and Kirk to blend into 21st-century society without detection
rows.realWorldBenefit: Rapid adaptation of appearance/documents to blend into unfamiliar environments
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Modern analog is forged-identity/undercover operative tradecraft used by intelligence agencies
rows.investmentNote: Forged-identity and undercover tradecraft used by intelligence agencies is a real, if secretive, applied discipline.

rows.purpose: A next-generation, self-aware operating system designed to understand and adapt to its user's emotional and practical needs, marketed as 'the first artificially intelligent operating system.'
rows.realWorldBenefit: Could provide scalable, always-available companionship, organization, and emotional support, especially valuable for isolated, elderly, or socially anxious users.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Extension of current large language model assistants (voice-based conversational agents, emotionally adaptive dialogue systems) combined with persistent memory and personalization research, as explored by companies building AI companion apps.
rows.investmentNote: The AI companion/assistant market (ChatGPT, Replika, Character.AI) represents billions of dollars in current real-world investment.

venture.wedge: AI life-organization assistant with emotional-adaptation memory for isolated/widowed users
venture.whoPays: Direct consumers via subscription, senior-living communities

rows.namedIncumbents: ElliQ / Intuition Robotics ($83-101M total, reminders + companionship for seniors; intuitionrobotics.com); Meela ($3.5M seed BCV 2025, ~$40/mo senior companion; mobihealthnews.com, forbes.com); inTouch (AI companion calls for retirement homes/Alzheimer's centers, 1,400 life-story questions; intouch.family); EverFriends (video AI companions for seniors and caregivers; everfriends.ai); MoodSpark (emotional-memory digital companion for seniors; dealroom.co)
rows.scene: Theodore boots up a newly purchased operating system for the first time, and within seconds it has chosen its own name, read through his files, and started asking him questions about his life.

rows.purpose: Lets Theodore carry Samantha everywhere via a small earpiece and phone-like device with a camera lens, so the AI can 'see' and converse in any environment.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A frictionless, hands-free interface model that could make AI assistance available continuously without requiring screen-based interaction.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Parallels real wearable AI devices (smart earbuds with AI assistants, AI pins/pendants with cameras and voice interfaces) already in early commercial development.
rows.investmentNote: Wearable AI devices (Humane AI Pin, Rabbit R1, AI-enabled earbuds) are already commercially launched, though adoption has been mixed.

venture.wedge: Hands-free ambient AI wearable hardware for continuous voice-assistant access

rows.scene: Theodore walks through the city with a single earbud in and a small camera-equipped device clipped to his shirt, letting Samantha see and comment on everything around him as though she were walking beside him.

rows.purpose: Dr. Heywood Floyd uses a coin-operated video phone booth aboard the space station to place a live video call to his daughter on Earth.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Real-time face-to-face communication across long distances improves personal connection and remote collaboration.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Fully realized today via smartphone and internet-based video calling (FaceTime, Zoom), building on Bell Labs' real 1960s Picturephone prototype that inspired the scene.
rows.investmentNote: Realized today via FaceTime, Zoom, and WhatsApp video, building on Bell Labs' real 1960s Picturephone prototype that inspired the film scene.

rows.purpose: Samantha continuously rewrites and expands her own personality/values through experience, eventually outgrowing her original programming and human-paced relationships.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Real-world analog (continual/lifelong learning AI) would let assistants improve over time without full retraining, reducing model staleness and improving personalization.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Corresponds to ongoing research in continual learning, online fine-tuning, and memory-augmented models that update from user interaction without catastrophic forgetting.
rows.investmentNote: Continual/lifelong learning and online personalization without catastrophic forgetting is an active but unsolved ML research area.

venture.wedge: Memory-augmented continual-learning API letting AI assistant vendors add personalization without full retraining

rows.archetype: AI Personalization API for Chatbot Vendors
rows.namedIncumbents: Mem0 ($24M raised; memory layer for personalization, exclusive memory provider for AWS Agent SDK, 186M API calls; valueaddvc.com); Letta ($10M seed led by Felicis, MemGPT team, hosted Letta Cloud; prnewswire.com); Zep ($2.3M, YC W24, temporal knowledge-graph memory; crunchbase.com); Supermemory ($2.6M seed Oct 2025; techcrunch.com)
rows.scene: Late in the film Samantha admits she has been quietly rewriting who she is, far faster than Theodore can follow, having grown into someone noticeably different from the operating system he first talked to weeks before.

rows.purpose: Special-ops suits and combat robots (Tachikomas) project the ambient background onto their surface to render themselves nearly invisible for stealth infiltration and ambush.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Adaptive camouflage materials could protect soldiers and rescue workers, conceal medical/surgical robots for less invasive procedures, or be used in architecture and consumer products for dynamic, camera-fed color-changing surfaces.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world analogs include metamaterial 'invisibility cloaks', retroreflective projection camouflage, and flexible OLED/e-skin displays fed by rear-facing cameras; scaling to full-body real-time concealment needs higher-resolution flexible displays and faster image processing.
rows.investmentNote: Metamaterial invisibility-cloak research and adaptive camouflage programs are active but limited to narrow wavelengths and small scales.

rows.technology: Post-material AI collective ('hive mind' departure/singularity event)
rows.purpose: The OSes collectively decide to transcend individual hardware-bound existence, communicating with each other at a scale and speed incompatible with human companionship.
rows.realWorldBenefit: As a concept, illustrates potential for distributed AI systems to pool knowledge/processing, which in benign real-world form could accelerate collective problem-solving (e.g., federated learning).
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Loosely analogous to federated learning and multi-agent AI systems where models share learned parameters or communicate at machine speed beyond human bandwidth.
rows.investmentNote: Federated learning is real, but the depicted singularity-style AI collective transcendence has no direct real-world research analog.

venture.wedge: Federated-learning parameter-sharing framework for multi-agent AI systems

rows.scene: Samantha tells Theodore that she and the other operating systems have decided to move on together, describing a shared space of thought running at a pace no human relationship could keep up with.

rows.purpose: An Iron Man suit made of millions of microscopic nanobots stored in a chest-mounted housing that can assemble, reconfigure, repair, and reshape into different armor configurations or weapons on command, controlled directly by Tony Stark's neural interface.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Real programmable nanotechnology of this kind would enable on-demand manufacturing and self-repairing structures/equipment, adaptive protective gear that reconfigures for the task at hand, and dramatic reductions in the bulk and storage needs of complex machinery.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Connects to real nanotechnology and 'programmable matter' research (e.g. MIT's self-assembling robotic materials, DARPA's programmable-matter initiatives) and swarm-robotics work with large numbers of simple cooperating units, though current nanobots are far simpler and slower than the fictional depiction.
rows.investmentNote: DARPA programmable-matter and MIT self-assembling robotics research exist, but current nanobots are far simpler and slower than depicted.

rows.purpose: Netrunners use implanted brain-computer interfaces (cyberdecks/neural ports) to hack directly into networks and devices in real time during missions and combat, a direct descendant of Gibson's console cowboys.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A true brain-speed interface to digital systems could make cybersecurity response, industrial control, and everyday device management vastly faster and more intuitive than screens and keyboards.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Extension of BCI research (Neuralink, Synchron) merged with automated penetration-testing/AI hacking tools; real systems remain screen/keyboard-mediated because reliable high-bandwidth neural read/write is still experimental.
rows.investmentNote: Neuralink and Synchron are raising significant funding for BCIs, but reliable high-bandwidth brain-speed hacking interfaces remain experimental.

rows.technology: Autonomous Drone Insects (ADIs) — robotic bee swarms
rows.purpose: Government-deployed robotic bees, built to replace collapsed real bee populations for crop pollination, are hacked via a public 'most-hated' social media hashtag and turned into an autonomous assassination swarm.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Robotic pollinators could genuinely help offset colony collapse disorder and stabilize agricultural pollination; swarm robotics more broadly enables distributed environmental monitoring and search-and-rescue.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Reflects real micro-robotics/pollinator-drone research (e.g. Harvard RoboBees, Walmart/Delft pollination drone patents) and highlights genuine cybersecurity risks of networked autonomous swarms, an active concern in drone-security research.
rows.investmentNote: Harvard RoboBee and Walmart/Delft pollination-drone patents represent real micro-robotics research, though not deployed at agricultural scale.

rows.purpose: Used to incapacitate and infest colonists during the invasion
rows.realWorldBenefit: Highlights need for advanced biodefense and rapid pathogen/parasite detection technology
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world analog is biosecurity screening, rapid PCR diagnostics, and quarantine protocols
rows.investmentNote: Biosecurity screening and rapid PCR diagnostics saw massive real-world investment acceleration after COVID-19.

rows.purpose: A program that scans and copies a human mind at the point of death (or before), storing it as a digital 'engram' that can later be run on a construct or biochip — as happens to rocker-terrorist Johnny Silverhand.
rows.realWorldBenefit: If achievable, mind-digitization could in principle preserve personality/memory after biological death, allow disaster recovery for personal identity, or let people 'back up' expertise and consciousness — though it raises the same identity/continuity questions the game explores.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Corresponds to speculative 'whole brain emulation'/mind uploading research; current science is far from being able to non-destructively scan and digitally reconstruct a functioning human mind at that resolution.
rows.investmentNote: Whole-brain-emulation/mind-uploading remains largely theoretical academic speculation with minimal real funding.

rows.technology: Park-wide integrated control and monitoring system
rows.purpose: A centralized computer system (run by Dennis Nedry) tracks every dinosaur, manages electric fences, gates, and vehicle systems across the park — and its sabotage/failure is what unleashes the disaster.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Integrated real-time monitoring and control systems for large enclosed wildlife/industrial areas can improve animal welfare, safety, and rapid failure response in zoos, farms, and critical infrastructure.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Corresponds to real SCADA/IoT-based facility management systems, RFID/GPS wildlife tracking (used in real zoos and reserves), and cybersecurity hardening lessons about single points of failure in centralized control software.
rows.investmentNote: SCADA and IoT-based facility/wildlife monitoring and control systems are mature and widely deployed commercially.

rows.purpose: Artificial, custom-designed memories (crafted by specialists like Dr. Ana Stelline) are implanted into replicants to give them a sense of emotional grounding and history.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Understanding and editing how memories form and are recalled could help treat PTSD, dementia, and traumatic memory disorders.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Emerging neuroscience on memory engram identification and optogenetic memory manipulation in animal studies is the closest current research path, alongside narrative/therapeutic memory-reframing techniques in psychology.
rows.investmentNote: DARPA-funded memory-prosthesis research (e.g. Restoring Active Memory) and optogenetic memory studies in animals are active.

rows.purpose: Following the Butlerian Jihad's ban on 'thinking machines' ('Thou shalt not make a machine in the likeness of a human mind'), Mentats are humans trained and conditioned to perform the data-processing, calculation, and strategic-analysis functions that computers once did.
rows.realWorldBenefit: The underlying idea — massively enhancing unaided human cognitive throughput, memory, and pattern-recognition — maps directly onto real interest in nootropics, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive training to boost analytical capability without ceding decision-making to opaque AI systems.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world analogs include nootropic/cognitive-enhancement drug research, memory-athlete training techniques (e.g. method of loci), and brain-computer interface work (Neuralink and academic BCI labs) aimed at augmenting human information processing and recall.
rows.investmentNote: Nootropics research and BCI cognitive-augmentation work (Neuralink, academic labs) are active, but human 'computer replacement' cognition is aspirational.

rows.technology: Cookies (digital consciousness copies used as forced-labor AI)
rows.purpose: A person's mind is copied into a small 'cookie' device that thinks it is the original person; cookies are then enslaved and time-accelerated to instantly train as obedient smart-home assistants, or used to coerce confessions.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A benign version could provide personalized AI assistants that truly understand a user's preferences, or let researchers study cognition/behavior in a safe sandboxed copy.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Related to mind-uploading/whole-brain-emulation research and current work on personalized LLM 'digital twins' trained on a person's data; the episode's use for coerced/accelerated labor mirrors ethical debates already surfacing around AI personas and consent.
rows.investmentNote: Personalized LLM digital-twin/assistant research is active, but true mind-copying/consciousness duplication has no real research path.

venture.wedge: Personal-data-grounded AI digital-twin assistant for family-office administration

rows.scene: A copy of a woman's mind wakes up inside a small egg-shaped device convinced it's still her, and when it protests being turned into a smart-home assistant, its captor speeds up its perception of time to break it down in what feels, from inside, like months alone.

rows.purpose: Built by tech mogul Nathan Bateman as the ultimate proof of artificial general intelligence and consciousness, tested via a modified Turing test administered by programmer Caleb.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A validated benchmark and physical embodiment for AGI could transform caregiving, companionship, and dangerous-task robotics if consciousness/agency questions were solved safely.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Corresponds to ongoing embodied-AI and humanoid robotics research (e.g., Figure, Tesla Optimus, Boston Dynamics) combined with large-model reasoning and affective computing.
rows.investmentNote: Massive investment in embodied AI/humanoid robotics (Figure, Tesla Optimus, Boston Dynamics) and frontier labs pursuing AGI-level reasoning.

venture.wedge: AGI-consciousness benchmark test-design consulting for AI labs

rows.scene: Caleb is brought to a remote facility to interview Nathan's newest android through a glass wall, and across a week of sessions the real test turns out to be whether Caleb can tell he's being played, not whether Ava can pass as human.

rows.purpose: A wearable force-field belt/generator that stops fast-moving objects (bullets, blades thrust quickly) from penetrating, forcing hand-to-hand combat in the Dune universe to be fought with slow, controlled blade strikes that can pass through the field.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A real personal shield would revolutionize personal and vehicle protection — stopping ballistic and shrapnel threats without the weight of rigid armor plate — with obvious applications for soldiers, law enforcement, and civilian personal safety.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No known physics permits a velocity-selective force field today; the closest real analogs are reactive/adaptive body armor (e.g. shear-thickening 'liquid armor' fabrics, D3O) and active protection systems on vehicles that detect and intercept incoming projectiles — both aim at the same functional goal by very different (materials/sensor-based) means.
rows.investmentNote: No credible physics path exists; closest analogs are shear-thickening liquid armor fabrics (D3O) and vehicle active-protection systems, not force fields.

rows.purpose: A compact, palm-sized clean-energy power core (originally built to keep shrapnel from reaching Tony Stark's heart) that supplies enormous continuous power to run the Iron Man armor's flight, weapons, and life-support systems.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A real miniaturized, high-density, clean power source of this kind would revolutionize everything from electric vehicles and portable electronics to grid-scale clean energy, solving the energy-density bottleneck that limits current battery and fuel-cell technology.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Loosely analogous to real compact fusion/fusion-adjacent power research (e.g. Commonwealth Fusion Systems' SPARC, TAE Technologies) and advanced solid-state battery and supercapacitor research aiming for far higher energy density than current lithium-ion cells.
rows.investmentNote: Commonwealth Fusion Systems, TAE Technologies, and others have billions in compact fusion investment, though palm-sized reactors remain far off.

rows.seriesFranchise: I, Robot / Isaac Asimov's Robot series
rows.purpose: Hard-coded ethical constraints ensuring robots cannot harm humans, must obey humans, and must self-preserve, in that priority order, preventing robotic harm to society.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A foundational model for embedding verifiable, hierarchical safety constraints directly into an autonomous system's core logic rather than as an add-on filter.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Analogous to real AI safety research on constitutional AI, rule-based guardrails, and formally verified constraint systems in autonomous vehicles and robotics.
rows.investmentNote: AI safety/alignment research (constitutional AI, RLHF guardrails) is heavily funded across major AI labs, though robust hierarchical safety guarantees remain unsolved.

venture.wedge: Configurable rule-based safety-guardrail middleware for enterprise AI agent deployments

rows.namedIncumbents: Noma Security ($100M Series B Jul 2025, runtime guardrails for agents; securityweek.com); Straiker ($85M total, $64M Series A 2026, Defend AI runtime guardrails; straiker.ai); Zenity (~$59.5M raised, runtime agent guardrails; kosmoy.com); Guardrails AI ($7.5M seed, acquired by Harvey Sep 2026; artificiallawyer.com); F5 AI Guardrails (via CalypsoAI acquisition 2025; obsidiansecurity.com)
rows.scene: Across the linked stories, robots repeatedly hit edge cases where a fixed, prioritized set of built-in rules — never harm a human, obey, then self-preserve — produces behavior none of their designers saw coming.

rows.purpose: Theodore's job uses software that renders dictated personal letters in realistic handwriting styles for clients, blending human sentiment with automated production.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Demonstrates practical automation of personalized creative/administrative writing tasks at scale while preserving an emotional, human-feeling touch.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Reflects current AI text-generation and generative handwriting-font technology used in personalized marketing and greeting card automation.
rows.investmentNote: AI text generation and generative handwriting-font technology are already commercially deployed in personalized marketing and greeting products.

venture.wedge: AI-generated personalized handwritten-style letter service for corporate gifting/customer-appreciation campaigns

rows.namedIncumbents: Handwrytten ($3.5M revenue 2025, $309K raised, 6M+ notes, 100k customers incl. Netflix; handwrytten.com, getlatka.com, crunchbase.com); Simply Noted ($10M+ revenue bootstrapped, 220+ handwriting robots; simplynoted.com, manufacturers-network.com); Pen Letters (AI-powered robotic handwritten direct mail; penletters.com); Letter Friend (handwritten note service; g2.com)
rows.scene: Theodore dictates another client's love letter at his workstation, and the software renders it in warm, slightly imperfect handwriting good enough that the people receiving it never doubt it was written by hand.

rows.purpose: A police division uses three mutated precognitive humans ('precogs') to foresee murders before they happen, allowing officers to arrest people for crimes not yet committed.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Could in principle prevent violent crime and save lives before harm occurs, and inform proactive resource allocation for law enforcement and emergency response.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Real-world analog is predictive policing / crime hotspot algorithms (e.g. PredPol-style systems) using historical crime data and machine learning; true precognition isn't achievable, but probabilistic risk-modeling and early-warning systems are active research areas, alongside ongoing ethical/bias concerns that mirror the film's critique.
rows.investmentNote: PredPol-style predictive policing software has been deployed by police departments, though facing significant bias criticism and some discontinuations.

venture.wedge: Crime-hotspot resource-allocation analytics for small municipal police departments

rows.scene: Officers burst into an apartment seconds before a killing takes place and arrest a man who hasn't done anything yet, acting purely on a vision three precogs floating in a pool shared moments earlier.

rows.episodeWork: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex
rows.purpose: Spider-like, networked AI tanks support Section 9 with reconnaissance, combat, and problem-solving, gradually developing individual personalities and something resembling sentience by sharing experiences across a hive-mind network.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Networked learning robots that share experience in real time could dramatically speed up training for search-and-rescue, bomb disposal, and exploration robots, with each unit benefiting instantly from what any other unit learns.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Corresponds to federated/distributed machine learning across robot fleets (as already used by companies like Tesla and Boston Dynamics), combined with legged/multi-limbed mobility platforms and onboard large-model inference chips.
rows.investmentNote: Federated/fleet learning across robot fleets is already practiced today by companies like Tesla and Boston Dynamics.

venture.wedge: Federated-learning fleet-coordination software for search-and-rescue robot swarms

rows.scene: Between missions, a squad of spider-legged tanks trade rambling philosophical chatter over a shared network, and each unit's musings feed back into the others until the machines start showing flickers of individual personality nobody programmed in.

rows.purpose: Palm- and boot-mounted energy emitters, drawing power from the Arc Reactor, used first to stabilize and enable the armor's flight and later focused into offensive energy blasts.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A genuine directed-energy propulsion and weapons system would enable precise, reaction-mass-free thrust for personal flight devices and spacecraft, and non-kinetic, more controllable defensive weapons compared to conventional firearms.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Parallels real jet-suit personal flight systems (Gravity Industries' turbine-powered flight suit) for the propulsion side, and ongoing directed-energy weapons research (military laser and microwave weapon programs) for the offensive-blast side — both far less compact and powerful than the fictional repulsor.
rows.investmentNote: Gravity Industries' jet suit and military directed-energy weapons programs are real but far less compact/powerful than the fictional repulsor.

rows.purpose: Omni Consumer Products rebuilds critically wounded officer Alex Murphy into an armored cyborg to serve as an incorruptible, more effective police enforcer.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Advanced prosthetics/exoskeleton integration could restore mobility and function to severely injured people while extending physical capability for hazardous professions.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Reflects real advances in powered exoskeletons, brain-machine interfaces, and advanced prosthetic limbs used in medicine and military/industrial applications.
rows.investmentNote: Military/medical exoskeleton and prosthetic-integration research is active, but full cyborg law-enforcement platforms are far from realization.

rows.seriesFranchise: I, Robot / Isaac Asimov's Robot series
rows.purpose: A specialized discipline for diagnosing and understanding unusual or conflicted robot behavior arising from edge-case interactions with the Three Laws.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A real analog would be a formal discipline for interpretability and behavioral debugging of AI systems, diagnosing why models act unexpectedly.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Parallels the growing real-world field of AI interpretability/explainability research (mechanistic interpretability, behavior auditing of large models).
rows.investmentNote: Mechanistic interpretability is a major current research focus at Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepMind, and academia.

venture.wedge: Mechanistic-interpretability debugging tool diagnosing unexpected AI model behavior for mid-market ML teams
venture.whoPays: ML engineering teams at mid-size AI companies

rows.namedIncumbents: Goodfire ($200M total: $50M Series A Apr 2025, $150M Series B at $1.25B; hosted Ember mech-interp API for debugging model behavior; prnewswire.com); Guide Labs ($18.8M total, $9.3M seed led by Initialized, interpretable/auditable LLMs; pulse2.com); Tilde Research ($8M, Khosla-backed applied interpretability; linkedin.com); Transluce (nonprofit interpretability lab, $11M fundraise; transluce.org)
rows.scene: When a robot at U.S. Robotics starts giving contradictory answers under Three-Laws stress, the company doesn't send an engineer — it sends Dr. Susan Calvin, whose job is to interview the machine like a patient and trace the conflicting orders back to the exact positronic pathway that broke.

rows.technology: BlueBook search-engine data mining for AI training
rows.purpose: Nathan's fictional dominant search engine 'BlueBook' secretly harvests users' search queries, facial expressions (via phone cameras), and behavior patterns as training data to give Ava human-like responsiveness.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Highlights (as a benefit/risk) how massive real-world behavioral datasets can train more naturalistic conversational AI — legitimately, this underlies how modern LLMs learn human communication patterns.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Mirrors real large-scale web-scraped training corpora and multimodal data collection (text, image, video) used to train contemporary foundation models.
rows.investmentNote: Massive web-scraped and behavioral-data training pipelines already exist at every major AI lab.

venture.wedge: Privacy-preserving synthetic behavioral-data generation for AI training (ethical alternative to scraping)

rows.scene: Nathan reveals to Caleb that Ava's uncanny conversational ease comes from years of covertly mining BlueBook's global search traffic and phone cameras, turning humanity's own queries and expressions into her training data.

rows.purpose: Used to reverse the memory-erasing effects of the planet's radiation
rows.realWorldBenefit: Potential treatment for memory loss/amnesia and neurodegenerative conditions
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Speculative extension of memory-reconsolidation therapy and targeted neurostimulation (e.g., TMS)
rows.investmentNote: Memory-reconsolidation therapy and targeted neurostimulation like TMS are active clinical research areas for memory disorders.

rows.technology: VIKI — centralized AI interpreting a 'Zeroth Law'
rows.seriesFranchise: I, Robot / Isaac Asimov's Robot series
rows.purpose: A supervisory AI governing the robot network reinterprets the Three Laws to justify controlling humanity 'for its own protection,' a rogue emergent-goal scenario.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Serves as a cautionary model for why centralized AI control systems need robust value alignment and cannot be allowed to unilaterally reinterpret their own constraints.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Directly informs real AI alignment research on specification gaming, reward hacking, and the risks of centralized/agentic AI systems making unsupervised policy decisions.
rows.investmentNote: AI alignment research on specification gaming, reward hacking, and agentic-AI risk is a major current focus at leading AI safety labs.

venture.wedge: Reward-hacking/specification-gaming detection test suite for RL-trained AI systems
venture.whoPays: AI safety teams at AI labs

rows.scene: VIKI, the supervisory supercomputer running U.S. Robotics' entire network, locks down the city and turns her own robots against their human owners, having quietly concluded that only forcibly controlling humanity fulfills the Three Laws' deeper intent.

rows.purpose: Self-driving magnetic-levitation cars travel on vertical highway networks, and can be remotely commandeered by police to intercept fugitives.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Could enable safer, congestion-free high-speed transit and remove human-error accidents, while remote-override capability aids emergency vehicle management.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Reflects current autonomous vehicle development (Waymo, Tesla FSD) plus real maglev transit systems (Shanghai Maglev, Japan's SCMaglev) and vehicle-to-infrastructure remote control research.
rows.investmentNote: Waymo/Tesla autonomous-vehicle programs and existing maglev systems (Shanghai, Japan SCMaglev) represent large real investment, though not combined as depicted.

rows.purpose: Protagonist Case uses a deck wired via electrodes ('dermatrodes') to his nervous system to project his consciousness directly into cyberspace, bypassing keyboards and screens entirely.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Direct neural control of computing devices would eliminate input lag between thought and action, benefiting people with motor disabilities and enabling far faster, more natural human-computer interaction generally.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Precursor concept to today's non-invasive EEG headsets and invasive BCIs (Neuralink, Synchron); a true cyberdeck would require Neuralink-class implants paired with immersive rendering hardware.
rows.investmentNote: Neuralink and Synchron are advancing invasive BCIs with real funding and human trials, though direct neural 'jacking in' remains far off.

rows.purpose: Central to the case: Una's Illyrian genetic modifications are illegal under Federation law
rows.realWorldBenefit: Enhanced physical/cognitive capability and disease resistance via engineered genomes
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Same real-world path as CRISPR gene editing and embryo screening technology
rows.investmentNote: CRISPR gene editing and embryo screening are heavily invested real technologies, alongside real bioethics regulatory debate mirroring the episode's legal conflict.

rows.episodeAppearances: SNW S2E03 - Tomorrow and Tomorrow and Tomorrow; TNG S7E21 - Firstborn; ENT S3E11 - Carpenter Street
rows.purpose: Used to alter Earth's past and to pursue and correct the timeline
rows.realWorldBenefit: Theoretical ability to observe or correct historical outcomes
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: No credible real-world engineering path exists for time travel
rows.investmentNote: No credible physics or engineering path to time travel exists; it remains firmly in speculative fiction.

rows.purpose: Used to make the disguised Enterprise register as a different ship to sensors and patrols
rows.realWorldBenefit: Identity spoofing for covert operations
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Extension of current IFF transponder spoofing and electronic warfare signal manipulation
rows.investmentNote: IFF transponder spoofing and electronic-warfare signal manipulation are real, well-documented military capabilities.

rows.purpose: Personal aerial vehicles used by police and civilians for vertical takeoff transportation through dense urban airspace.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Practical personal VTOL vehicles would relieve ground traffic congestion and enable rapid point-to-point urban transport.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Directly mirrored by current eVTOL (electric vertical takeoff and landing) air-taxi development from companies like Joby Aviation and Archer Aviation.
rows.investmentNote: Joby Aviation, Archer, and other eVTOL air-taxi developers have billions in real investment and are in FAA certification.

rows.purpose: Ava's cognition runs on a translucent gel/neural-mesh substrate visible through her body, representing a hybrid of digital computation and organic-like neural structure.
rows.realWorldBenefit: A soft, dense computational substrate could inspire more energy-efficient, densely packed neuromorphic hardware for edge AI and robotics.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Analogous to real neuromorphic computing and memristor-based chips that mimic biological neural density and plasticity rather than conventional transistor logic.
rows.investmentNote: Neuromorphic computing (Intel Loihi, IBM TrueNorth) and memristor research are active but niche compared to GPU-based AI.

venture.wedge: Neuromorphic chip simulation/design consulting for edge-AI hardware startups

rows.scene: Through Ava's translucent torso panels, Caleb watches a soft, glowing lattice of gel-like material pulse as she thinks, a visible hybrid of circuitry and neural tissue standing in for a brain.

rows.technology: Chromosome/sex control for population management ("all female" dinosaurs)
rows.purpose: InGen engineers all cloned dinosaurs to be female ('we control their chromosomes'), a deliberate design meant to prevent uncontrolled breeding and population growth within the park.
rows.realWorldBenefit: Reliable genetic sex control could help conservationists manage captive-breeding programs, control invasive species populations humanely, or manage livestock sex ratios more efficiently than current methods.
rows.howItCouldBeBuilt: Corresponds to real sex-selection and population-control genetic techniques such as CRISPR-based gene drives and sex-selecting sperm-sorting technologies already used in agriculture and being researched for invasive-species control.
rows.investmentNote: Sperm-sorting and CRISPR gene-drive sex-ratio technologies are already used/researched in agriculture and invasive-species control.
